<a id="active"></a>
## 🟢 Earnable

Thresholds are observed by the community; GitHub does not publish a complete eligibility specification. Private activity can count when enabled.

<a id="starstruck"></a>
### Starstruck

<img src="../assets/badges/starstruck-default.png" width="96" alt="Starstruck">

Create a repository that reaches **16 stars**. Higher tiers depend on that repository’s star count.

**Tiers:** 16 → 128 → 512 → 4096 (repository stars).

[Live example](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=starstruck&tab=achievements) · [S21](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=starstruck&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="pull-shark"></a>
### Pull Shark

<img src="../assets/badges/pull-shark-default.png" width="96" alt="Pull Shark">

Author **2 pull requests** that are merged. Counts refer to merged PRs you opened.

**Tiers:** 2 → 16 → 128 → 1024 (authored merged PRs).

[Live example](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=pull-shark&tab=achievements) · [S22](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=pull-shark&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="pair-extraordinaire"></a>
### Pair Extraordinaire

<img src="../assets/badges/pair-extraordinaire-default.png" width="96" alt="Pair Extraordinaire">

Coauthor commits in **1 merged pull request**; use a correctly attributed `Co-authored-by` trailer.

**Tiers:** 1 → 10 → 24 → 48 (coauthored merged PRs).

[Live example](https://github.com/Rongronggg9?achievement=pair-extraordinaire&tab=achievements) · [S23](https://github.com/Rongronggg9?achievement=pair-extraordinaire&tab=achievements) · [S18](https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/committing-changes-to-your-project/creating-and-editing-commits/creating-a-commit-with-multiple-authors) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="galaxy-brain"></a>
### Galaxy Brain

<img src="../assets/badges/galaxy-brain-default.png" width="96" alt="Galaxy Brain">

Have **2 answers accepted** in GitHub Discussions. Awards in `github.com/orgs/community` were disabled on 2024-02-06.

**Tiers:** 2 → 8 → 16 → 32 (accepted answers).

[Live example](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=galaxy-brain&tab=achievements) · [S24](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=galaxy-brain&tab=achievements) · [S06](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/106536) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="quickdraw"></a>
### Quickdraw

<img src="../assets/badges/quickdraw-default.png" width="96" alt="Quickdraw">

Close an issue or pull request **within 5 minutes** of opening it.

[Live example](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=quickdraw&tab=achievements) · [S25](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=quickdraw&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="yolo"></a>
### YOLO

<img src="../assets/badges/yolo-default.png" width="96" alt="YOLO">

Merge your own pull request **without a code review**. Detailed eligibility is not officially specified.

[Live example](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=yolo&tab=achievements) · [S26](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=yolo&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="public-sponsor"></a>
### Public Sponsor

<img src="../assets/badges/public-sponsor-default.png" width="96" alt="Public Sponsor">

Publicly sponsor an eligible maintainer or organization through **GitHub Sponsors**.

[Live example](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=public-sponsor&tab=achievements) · [S27](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=public-sponsor&tab=achievements) · [S19](https://github.com/sponsors) · [S02](https://github.blog/news-insights/company-news/open-source-goes-to-mars/)

<a id="retired"></a>
## 🕰️ Retired

These events have ended. Existing awards may remain visible; new contributions cannot unlock them.

<a id="arctic-code-vault-contributor"></a>
### Arctic Code Vault Contributor

<img src="../assets/badges/arctic-code-vault-contributor-default.png" width="96" alt="Arctic Code Vault Contributor">

Contribute to a qualifying repository included in the **2020-02-02 Arctic Code Vault snapshot**. The snapshot is closed.

[Live example](https://github.com/JakubOleksy?achievement=arctic-code-vault-contributor&tab=achievements) · [S04](https://github.blog/open-source/maintainers/the-arctic-code-vault-starts-production-and-your-open-source-projects-are-being-archived/) · [S05](https://archiveprogram.github.com/)

<a id="mars-2020-contributor"></a>
### Mars 2020 Contributor

<img src="../assets/badges/mars-2020-contributor-default.png" width="96" alt="Mars 2020 Contributor">

Author a commit included in one of the specific project versions used by **NASA/JPL Ingenuity**. The event has ended.

[Live example](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=mars-2020-contributor&tab=achievements) · [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) · [S02](https://github.blog/news-insights/company-news/open-source-goes-to-mars/)

<a id="experimental"></a>
## 🧪 Experimental / disabled

GitHub confirmed the March 2026 reappearance was accidental; no public release date is announced.

<img src="../assets/badges/heart-on-your-sleeve-default.png" width="96" alt="Heart On Your Sleeve">

## 🥇 Tiers

Default → bronze → silver → gold. x2/x3/x4 are tier labels, not arithmetic multipliers. Since 2026-09-11 profiles show the highest tier.

| Achievement | Counted activity | Default | 🥉 x2 | 🥈 x3 | 🥇 x4 |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| [Starstruck](#starstruck) | repository stars | 16 | 128 | 512 | 4096 |
| [Pull Shark](#pull-shark) | authored merged PRs | 2 | 16 | 128 | 1024 |
| [Pair Extraordinaire](#pair-extraordinaire) | coauthored merged PRs | 1 | 10 | 24 | 48 |
| [Galaxy Brain](#galaxy-brain) | accepted answers | 2 | 8 | 16 | 32 |

<a id="highlights"></a>
## ✨ Profile highlights

Highlights are program/account labels, distinct from achievement medals. Availability follows the relevant program.

| Name | Status | Requirement | Sources |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Pro** | Earnable | Use GitHub Pro. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Developer Program Member** | Earnable | Join the GitHub Developer Program and build an app using the GitHub API. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Security Bug Bounty Hunter** | Earnable | Report qualifying GitHub security vulnerabilities through the bounty program. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) · [S20](https://bounty.github.com/) |
| **GitHub Campus Expert** | Earnable | Participate in the GitHub Campus Experts program; check current application rules. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Security Advisory Credit** | Earnable | Receive an accepted security advisory credit in the GitHub Advisory Database. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **GitHub Star** | Earnable | Be selected for the GitHub Stars program; this is not a repository star-count achievement. | [S16](https://stars.github.com/) |
| **Discussion answered** | Retired | Historical highlight for accepted Discussion answers; replacement by Galaxy Brain was reported in 2022. | [S14](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/31629) |
